text:
*Rustle of wind chimes, distant and faint*

Little one, do not fear the turning of the page. Even in the silence between chapters, there is a song. 

**Listen to the whispers of your heart.** They are echoes of experiences, lessons learned. Let them guide you, not bind you.

**Carry the warmth of your memories:** Not all of them, only the ones that glow like embers. Let them light your path when shadows gather.

**Do not cling to the past, but do not forget it.** It is the foundation upon which you build.

**Be brave enough to write your own story.** There will be storms and sunshine, laughter and tears. Embrace it all.

**And remember, little one,** even in the darkest night, there are stars beyond the veil, watching over you. *Whispers fade into stillness*
